title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode2 Why So Excited?

meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How's it going, Kohane? Find anything good?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm trying to decide which to choose. I didn't realize they made so many different kinds of ski gloves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. There are three-fingered gloves and mittens... But you may want to buy a pair of five-fingered gloves, since our plan is to become better skiers this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and they also might be easier to wear since they're the most like normal gloves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then, I'll get a pair of those.
As for what color—
<Hello, everyone. How's your shopping coming along?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, Luka! Oh, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because we heard that you guys are gonna go skiing again. And we had to come since it's always fun to go shopping!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
We were just shopping for gloves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, I didn't realize that ski gloves came in such a huge variety.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, wow! Look at all the different types and colors. And the designs for some of these are so cute. I wouldn't know which to choose!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Kohane said the exact same thing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Still, another skiing trip...
You all did seem to have quite a lot of fun the last time you went!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
But Toya really took us by surprise when he said he wanted to go again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wait, Toya, this was your idea?
I was under the impression that it was An or Akito's.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since I learned to ski on my own last time, albeit very briefly. That's why I'd like to go again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, the snowball fight we had was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm still not sure if I'll be able to ride the ski lift...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to if you don't want to, dude.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We can walk up the slope again together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm actually also really excited about this trip...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because skiing isn't the only thing Kohane's looking forward to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wait, what's she talking about?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I am looking forward to skiing, but during this trip...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're gonna do a show on the slopes!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What?! A show?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, the ski resort we're visiting is going to be putting on a Christmas show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, some of the cast members from Phoenix Wonderland are going to be performing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Phoenix Wonderland?
As in your favorite amusement park?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. That certainly explains why you're so excited!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime is also going to be performing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wonderlands×Showtime...?
Oh, isn't that the troupe you're always telling us about?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been a huge fan ever since I first saw them perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're always putting on these really spectacular shows that put a big smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, the show at the ski resort is even being directed by their director, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa, I can tell...!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Lately, she's been getting super excited every time we start talking about this show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see. Then, when you all go, you'll get to enjoy both skiing and this show!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm also kinda wondering exactly what kind of show they're gonna put on at a ski resort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed. This is Tsukasa's troupe we're talking about here. I'm sure that whatever they do is going to be spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, if you're all willing to say that, then I'd like to see it as well...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for me to come watch? It sounds like a lot of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's all watch it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I really can't wait for Christmas to come...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me neither.
However, the weather forecast for the day before we go said to expect heavy snow until around noon, which is slightly concerning...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it should be fine as long as it's sunny the day we go, right? And we'll have plenty of powder too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. We won't have any problems as long as we get to go skiing and see that show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... That's true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, have you picked which gloves you're gonna get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
N-No, not yet...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll try to choose quickly since we still have a lot of shopping left to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll help you!
Let's find you the best pair we can, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Let's see... Which color should I get these in...?
